input: All chronological local groups; first/middle/last up to three left/front/right triptychs per group. No scoring labels, simulator positions or expected region count.
identity: Each group exactly once in one concrete region or boundary group; insufficient evidence may remain unknown. Unshown images inherit group identity provisionally.
annotations: Optional actual representative references only: near-door, boundary or different-region. Preserve per-image dissent without automatically overriding group identity. No mandatory annotation quota.
validation: Actual per-group evidence required. Collect detected field/reference/coverage errors together; return previous answer and actionable feedback. Never manufacture image evidence.
retrySelection: First valid answer, not highest score; preserve all responses and feedback. Transport failures recorded separately, no implicit SDK retries.
evaluation: Fixed core queries keep unknowns in denominator. Evaluate whole-boundary detection and annotation instability separately. No annotation automatically becomes location ground truth.
scope: Offline research only; production unchanged. Two val5 runs core28/28, boundary recall25%/0%, near-door annotations5/0. No established general reliability or complete40-image acceptance.
supersedes: test.4 boundary-region v1 as preferred research baseline; original code, input hashes, failures, scores and tags remain reproducible. Website keeps its existing predictions; no arbitrary choice of a repeat.
